hideAccountResetCredentials.description: Option to hide the self-service password reset (SSPR) hyperlinks such as 'Can't access your account?', 'Forgot my password' and 'Reset it now' on the sign-in form.

hideCannotAccessYourAccount.description: Option to hide the self-service password reset (SSPR) 'Can't access your account?' hyperlink on the sign-in form.

hideForgotMyPassword.description: Option to hide the self-service password reset (SSPR) 'Forgot my password' hyperlink on the sign-in form.

hidePrivacyAndCookies.description: Option to hide the 'Privacy & Cookies' hyperlink in the footer.

hideResetItNow.description: Option to hide the self-service password reset (SSPR) 'reset it now' hyperlink on the sign-in form.

hideTermsOfUse.description: Option to hide the 'Terms of Use' hyperlink in the footer.
